ei.title: 발과 다리가 우리의 생각과 감정을 반영하게 된 이유

fullPassage: The writer and zoologist Desmond Morris observed that our feet communicate exactly what we think and feel more honestly than any other part of our bodies. Why are the feet and legs such accurate reflectors of our sentiments? For millions of years, long before humans spoke, our legs and feet reacted to environmental threats (e.g., hot sand, ill-tempered lions) instantaneously, without the need for conscious thought. Our limbic brains made sure that our feet and legs reacted as needed by either ceasing motion, running away, or kicking at a potential threat. This survival regimen, retained from our ancestral heritage, has served us well and continues to do so today. In some cultures, therefore, barefoot walking is considered a spiritual practice, connecting the individual to the ancestors. In fact, these age-old reactions are still so hardwired in us that when we are presented with something dangerous or even disagreeable, our feet and legs still react as they did in prehistoric times.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 전달하다(communicate), 멈추다(ceasing), 고정된(hardwired)이 문맥상 적절합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① communicate — ceasing — hardwired: 발이 우리 생각을 '전달하고', 위협에 움직임을 '멈추며', 반응이 '고정되어' 있음.
❌ ② disguise — ceasing — hardwired: (A) 발이 생각을 '위장'하는 것이 아니라 '전달'함.
❌ ③ communicate — increasing — hardwired: (B) 위협에 움직임을 '증가'시키는 것이 아니라 '멈춤'.
❌ ④ communicate — ceasing — temporary: (C) 반응이 '일시적'이 아니라 선사시대부터 '고정'됨.

❌ ② honestly — fictional — spiritual: (B) '가상의' 위협이 아니라 '잠재적' 위협에 반응.
✅ ③ honestly — potential — spiritual: 정직하게 전달, 잠재적 위협, 영적 실천 — 모두 적절.
❌ ④ honestly — potential — commercial: (C) 맨발 걷기는 '상업적'이 아니라 '영적' 실천.

det.korean: (A)에서 reflectors = 반영하는 것 / (B)에서 reflectors = 반사판 (물리적 장치)
det.analysis:
✅ ② indicators (나타내는 것): (A)에서 reflectors는 감정을 '반영하는/나타내는 것'의 비유적 의미.
❌ ① mirrors (거울): 물리적 거울이 아닌 비유적 표현이므로 indicator가 더 적절.
❌ ③ devices (장치): (B)의 물리적 반사판 의미.
❌ ④ surfaces (표면): 물리적 의미로 (A)와 맞지 않음.
det.tip: reflectors: (A) 반영하는 것(비유) vs (B) 반사판(물리적 장치)

questions.passage: The writer and zoologist Desmond Morris observed that our feet communicate exactly what we think and feel more honestly than any other part of our bodies. Why are the feet and legs such accurate reflectors of our sentiments? For millions of years, long before humans spoke, our legs and feet reacted to environmental threats (e.g., hot sand, ill-tempered lions) instantaneously, without the need for conscious thought. Our limbic brains made sure that our feet and legs reacted as needed by either ceasing motion, running away, or kicking at a potential threat. This survival regimen, retained from our ancestral heritage, has served us well and continues to do so today. In some cultures, therefore, barefoot walking is considered a spiritual practice, connecting the individual to the __________. In fact, these age-old reactions are still so hardwired in us that when we are presented with something dangerous or even disagreeable, our feet and legs still react as they did in prehistoric times.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ancestors (조상): 맨발 걷기가 개인을 '조상'과 연결하는 영적 실천입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② ancestors: ancestral heritage와 연결되어 조상과의 연결이라는 맥락에 적합.
❌ ① threats: '위협'과 연결되는 것은 영적 실천과 무관.
❌ ③ sentiments: '감정'과 연결은 맨발 걷기의 맥락과 맞지 않음.
❌ ④ bodies: '신체'와 연결은 영적 의미가 없음.
det.tip: connecting the individual to the ancestors = 개인을 조상과 연결하는

det.korean: potential (잠재적인): 움직임 중단, 도주, 발차기로 '잠재적' 위협에 대응합니다.
